Program a fleet of service robots that scales with your business. Our centralized control system allows multi-robot orchestration with no deadlocks or congestion.

We’ve engineered all our autonomous mobile robots to evolve with your business. With multi-robot orchestration, we’re ensuring quality service moves at the speed of your success.

FAQ

Is Servi safe for use in my busy restaurant?

Servi is incredibly safe. Servi uses advanced sensors, including LiDAR and cameras, to map its environment and safely navigate around people, tables, and obstacles. It continuously detects changes in its surroundings and automatically reroutes to reach its destination efficiently.

Does Servi replace restaurant staff?

Not at all. Servi is designed to assist staff, not replace them. By handling repetitive delivery tasks like running food or bussing tables, Servi allows employees to focus on hospitality, guest interaction, and service quality.

Is Servi compliant for use in a restaurant environment?

Servi is NSF-certified. This means Servi is compliant to local health codes that might prevent other service robots from operating in foodservice spaces.
